## Variables

```go
var ErrConnectionLost = errors.New("sparkplugb: connection lost")
```

ErrConnectionLost is passed to ConnectOpts.OnConnectionLost when the transport stops being connected, whether the broker dropped the session or Disconnect was called on the transport directly.
